title: Add fault injection tests for pool exhaustion and INIT failure error paths
description:
ASAN confirmed zero errors on normal paths. The remaining unexercised paths are:
1. Pool exhaustion during HMAC Final (pool acquired at Final time, not SetKey/Update time).
2. Pool exhaustion during ECDSA sign/verify.
3. INIT ioctl failure during HMAC Final (after Update calls have already claimed data).

Add crypto2dev_sim_set_ioctl_fail(n) to the simulator, and three tests that exercise these paths under ASAN to confirm: WC_HW_E is returned, devCtx is freed and NULLed, key material is zeroed, and no leaks.

Also fix wolfssl-681.1 through wolfssl-681.4 as part of this work (the tests depend on the log message fixes and ECC COPY guard).
